description: The upstream spec lets the send operations take `text/plain`, `application/json` or `application/octet-stream`, but the converted model drops the Content-Type, so the generated client JSON-encoded the string body (`"hello"` arrived as a JSON string). Send the body verbatim as `text/plain` by default, and add a `contentType` header member so callers can send JSON or binary.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Media type of `body`: `text/plain` (the default, clients receive `dataType: "text"`), `application/json` (`dataType: "json"`), or `application/octet-stream` (`dataType: "binary"`).

patches.value: The message payload, sent as-is under `contentType`.
